title: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. translated_title: NF-VLA：用于视觉-语言-动作学习的归一化流基线方法
translated_abstract: 自回归归一化流（NFs）为学习和采样连续机器人动作提供了可处理的概率密度。我们证明，仅用单一的极大似然目标，就能训练出在操作基准测试中与领先方法具有竞争力的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。我们提出NF-VLA，它将条件自回归归一化流与基于分数的动作精炼相结合。其“深-浅”架构将视觉、语言和本体感知的前缀条件集中在高容量的深块中，而无条件的浅块则提供共享的可逆动作变换。视觉-语言主干与流模型在经高斯平滑的动作块上通过精确极大似然进行联合训练。同一学习到的密度在推理时提供单次基于分数的修正，对生成的动作进行精炼以补偿训练时的平滑处理，而无需单独训练的去噪器。在LIBERO上从……训练（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: NF-VLA提出了一种以自回归归一化流为核心的视觉-语言-动作学习基线，通过单一精确极大似然目标联合训练视觉-语言主干与流模型，并利用同一学习密度在推理时进行基于分数的动作修正，在操作基准上达到与领先方法相当的性能。
en_tdlr: NF-VLA presents a normalizing-flow baseline for vision-language-action learning, where a single exact maximum-likelihood objective jointly trains the vision-language backbone and flow, and the learned density provides score-based action refinement at inference without a separately trained denoiser.
